name: Nagi
source:
A youth who lived along with Chihiro as a high school student in the modern day. Though he is also originally from the other world.
He holds great spiritual power and has a great skill called "Onidoutsukai" but he is actually a lazy and apathetic person.
He has a sharp tongue and takes a cold attitude towards his comrades, but he does have a helpful side.

He is technically the first Suzaku of Earth of the series.
His particular trait is "Sorrow".
